root_cause: Three independent defects combined: non-Buffer Instagram provider IDs were passed through Buffer reconciliation, Buffer sync kept calling during an active 24h rate-limit window, and the Instagram media router incremented attempts on every identical preflight blocker. In addition, Powerhouse had no valid COMPOSIO_API_KEY, so the daily autonomous route could not use the direct Instagram transport.
prevention_rule: Instagram provider identity is isolated by provider ownership; Buffer calls are forbidden while the canonical circuit is open; identical replacement blockers do not increment attempts; the exact proven Mira Reel is reused across recovery; Composio remains primary and Buffer is a bounded secondary transport only when its circuit is closed. Non-Mira content, image fallback, second-winner generation, duplicate publication and Make are forbidden.

Powerhouse Composio runtime status had no valid API key / active account
media job reached attempts=162 before retry-stability fix
